test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.**

The teacher could judge that his intentions were ______, (**nefarious**) so he was not stopped from entering the hall.
solution: The correct answer is **"pious."**** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word** 'nefarious' **means wicked or criminal. (पापी, दुष्ट, अपराधी, अधर्मी, जघन्य) • **Example: ***That was a **nefarious**__ activity.* • **"Pious"** means devout or righteous. (धर्म में गहरा विश्‍वास करने या प्रदर्शित करने वाला; भक्त, धर्मपरायण) __ • **Example:** *She is a **pious**__ follower of the faith, never missing her prayers.* • In this context, the teacher did not stop the person from entering the hall because they could tell that their intentions were not wicked or criminal. • The antonym of **'nefarious'** is** 'pious.'** • The correct answer is Option 1. • The sentence could be rewritten as *"The teacher could tell that his intentions were not nefarious, so he was allowed to enter the hall."* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Traitorous"** means disloyal or treacherous. (विश्वासघाती) • **'Envious"** means jealous or covetous. (दूसरे के पास जो वस्‍तु है उसका इच्‍छुक) • **"Perfidious"** means deceitful or untrustworthy. (धोखेबाज या अविश्वसनीय) 1a0:Tb94, The correct answer is: Option 3** i.e. 'Aggreement'.
